title: Hulum's Lab Serum — original procedural soundscape
creative_direction: A quiet blue-white laboratory ambience built from subtle electrical room tone, sequoia-like wood grain and resonant creaks, a low serum pulse, a sparse original 8-bit minor-pentatonic motif, and a controlled low-frequency climax. The sound bed remains continuous across all four video segments; no hard-cut stingers.

stems.name: room_tone
stems.description: Soft ventilation and electrical hum with restrained stereo noise

stems.name: wood_grain
stems.description: Organic filtered noise and low resonant creaks, spaced like tension moving through heavy timber

stems.name: serum_pulse
stems.description: Low paired pulses with restrained harmonic shimmer, increasing toward the transformation climax

stems.name: bit_motif
stems.description: Original sparse C-minor-pentatonic 8-bit arpeggio; no sampled or borrowed melody

stems.name: climax
stems.description: Rising sub-frequency sweep, three low impacts and a metallic tail

timeline.description: Establish the quiet laboratory: room tone, low timber resonance, restrained space
Serum pulse enters and begins to establish a slow rhythmic body
Wood grain and the sparse 8-bit motif become more present as the transformation accumulates
Controlled low-frequency climax with three impacts and rising metallic resonance
The sound settles into a stable low hum and holds through the final image

master.note: Audio-only master target. Final video mux and sync verification are separate acceptance gates.

optional_sample_layer.policy: Enable only for a user-supplied or licensed sample with documented usage and transfer rights.

rights.note: Default renderer uses only original deterministic synthesis. No copyrighted music or external samples.
